sql: SELECT c.constructor_name, MIN(q.q3_time) FROM qualifying q JOIN constructors c ON c.constructor_id=q.constructor_id WHERE q.round=9 AND q.q3_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.constructor_id
SELECT r.driver_id, s.finish_position, r.finish_position FROM sprint_results s JOIN results r ON r.round=s.round AND r.driver_id=s.driver_id WHERE s.round=9

SELECT c.constructor_name, ROUND(SUM(r.points)*100.0/(SELECT SUM(points) FROM results WHERE round=9),2) FROM results r JOIN constructors c ON c.constructor_id=r.constructor_id WHERE r.round=9 GROUP BY c.constructor_id HAVING SUM(r.points)>0
SELECT driver_id, finish_position, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY grid_position - finish_position DESC, driver_id) FROM results WHERE round=9 AND finish_position IS NOT NULL

SELECT c.constructor_name, ROUND(AVG(p.duration_seconds),2) FROM pit_stops p JOIN results r ON r.round=p.round AND r.driver_id=p.driver_id JOIN constructors c ON c.constructor_id=r.constructor_id WHERE p.round=9 GROUP BY c.constructor_id ORDER BY AVG(p.duration_seconds)

SELECT d.driver_code, r.constructor_id, r.points, ROUND(100.0*r.points/SUM(r.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.constructor_id),2) AS pct FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id=r.driver_id WHERE r.round=9 AND r.points>0 ORDER BY r.constructor_id, pct DESC

SELECT d.driver_code, r.fastest_lap_seconds-(SELECT MIN(fastest_lap_seconds) FROM results WHERE round=9) AS gap FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id=r.driver_id WHERE r.round=9 AND r.fastest_lap_seconds-(SELECT MIN(fastest_lap_seconds) FROM results WHERE round=9)<=1.5 ORDER BY gap, d.driver_code

WITH t AS (SELECT driver_id, points FROM results WHERE round=9 UNION ALL SELECT driver_id, points FROM sprint_results WHERE round=9) SELECT driver_id, SUM(points) AS total FROM t GROUP BY driver_id HAVING SUM(points)>0 ORDER BY total DESC, driver_id

WITH t AS (SELECT p.driver_id, r.constructor_id, SUM(p.duration_seconds) tot, COUNT(*) n FROM pit_stops p JOIN results r ON r.round=p.round AND r.driver_id=p.driver_id WHERE p.round=9 GROUP BY p.driver_id, r.constructor_id HAVING COUNT(*)>=2) SELECT c.constructor_name, d.driver_code, ROUND(t.tot,2), RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.constructor_id ORDER BY t.tot DESC) FROM t JOIN constructors c ON c.constructor_id=t.constructor_id JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id=t.driver_id

SELECT constructor_name, driver_code, standing_position, points FROM (SELECT c.constructor_name, d.driver_code, s.standing_position, s.points, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.constructor_id ORDER BY s.standing_position, s.driver_id) rn FROM driver_standings s JOIN constructors c ON c.constructor_id=s.constructor_id JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id=s.driver_id WHERE s.round=9) WHERE rn=1

SELECT r.round, r.race_name, (SELECT SUM(points) FROM sprint_results s WHERE s.round=r.round) sp, (SELECT SUM(points) FROM results x WHERE x.round=r.round) rp, ROUND(100.0*(SELECT SUM(points) FROM sprint_results s WHERE s.round=r.round)/((SELECT SUM(points) FROM sprint_results s WHERE s.round=r.round)+(SELECT SUM(points) FROM results x WHERE x.round=r.round)),2) FROM races r WHERE r.has_sprint=1 ORDER BY r.round
